hook: How to do an easy run
source_problem: Zone 2 usually drifts upward slowly, not suddenly.
exact_reddit_language: Zone 2 keeps drifting into zone 3 and 4.

hook_quality.hook: How to do an easy run
hook_quality.rationale: 60/70; 6 words; viral_format_pattern; pain 10/10; curiosity 7/10; simplicity 10/10; passes quality gate

cta: Try Coachi if you always run too fast.

reddit_background_and_vibe.background: long forest road, enough depth to feel like the runner has been moving for a while
reddit_background_and_vibe.vibe: honest endurance, slight late-run fatigue, controlled effort, not a sprint
reddit_background_and_vibe.reddit_background: Zone 2 keeps drifting into zone 3 and 4.

first_image_prompt_adaptation: during-run or late-run action moment: the runner is sweaty, breathing steadily, satisfied but aware he had to control the effort

stable_traits: same face family across all Coachi organic running visuals
realistic sweat on face and shirt
sharper cheek and brow detail in the stronger 2026-04-26 watch-stole-the-run style
character_anchor.variation_policy: Keep the Coachi face family stable, but prefer the stronger 2026-04-26 watch-stole-the-run viral face/style direction over the too-clean park-portrait look. Rotate workout phase, top, eyewear, shorts, weather, light, and camera angle per pack. Default to no headwear; use caps/headbands only occasionally so every video does not look the same. If eyewear is selected, it must be black running glasses.
character_anchor.watch_rule: Default: no visible watch. If the hook is explicitly about watch anxiety, a small unbranded sports watch may appear, but never use readable UI, close-ups, or watch-checking poses.

workout_phase.label: during-workout
workout_phase.moment: runner in the middle of the session with steady controlled effort
workout_phase.body_language: natural stride, consistent cadence, focused breathing, no stutter step or unnatural turn
workout_phase.prompt_cue: show the runner moving naturally during the run with visible route context and believable motion

avatar_variation.angle: waist-up cooldown angle on the selected route

checks: single workout phase selected before prompt generation
avatar lighting normalized to deck lighting family
weather normalized to selected lighting family
base image remains text-free for local Sharp/Canvas overlay

schema_prompt_template: photorealistic athletic runner in {scene}, natural route, premium but believable, clean center space for headline
production_rules: Every slideshow has an explicit emotion, one Images 2.0 hook, one generated avatar world, and one final CTA.
Slide hook and slides 1-6 should use the source-backed TikTok slideshow text bank before any generic AI wording.
Do not generate all slideshow images in one Images 2.0 request.
Do not bake overlay text into the image.
Keep the full deck in one visual world and one lighting family.
Do not mix hills, lakes, and mountains in the same slideshow.
Use Supabase/curated library assets for slides 2 through the CTA slide.
Composite all text locally with Sharp/Canvas.
